entities.summary: Patrik Jensen (b. 1969-11-24, Linköping) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Linköping and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
